title: Developer Experience Initiative Radar: Cohort Retention & Risk Signal Mesh
creator: Priya Nambiar
description: Create a lightweight, reusable initiative radar and associated artifacts to track Developer Experience programs (SDKs, docs, quickstarts) across cycles. The deliverable includes: 1) a cohort retention heatmap and microlearning matrix to measure and improve first-30-day activation, 2) an initiative radar dashboard for product and GTM stakeholders, and 3) a 'risk signal mesh' — a set of automated signals and playbook links that surface regressions or churn risk from telemetry (docs traffic, SDK install, sample app runs, support tickets). This ticket is to plan, prototype, and ship the first iteration for Cycle 2026-W08 with instrumentation and clear owners.
acceptance_criteria: Radar dashboard shows active initiatives and their quadrant (Adopt/Optimize/At-Risk/Paused) with live metrics
Cohort retention heatmap implemented for first-30-day retention across three cohorts (Quickstart, SDK, Docs-guided) with weekly refresh
Microlearning matrix published in Confluence with curriculum items mapped to metric impact and owner

Risk signal mesh: 5 automated signals implemented (drop in SDK installs, docs session time, sample-app run failures, increase in onboarding support tickets, decline in new API keys) with linked runbooks
Owners assigned for each signal and an escalation path defined in the runbook
Basic alerts wired to Slack channel #devx-ops for P1/P2 signals
success_metrics: Increase 30-day activation retention by 12% for Quickstart cohort after 6 weeks
Reduce time-to-first-success (sample-app run) by 20% for beginners
Reduce onboarding support tickets per new active dev by 15% within the quarter
Radar adoption: >80% of active PM/Design/Eng initiative leads reference the radar in weekly syncs
